answer: Adaptive homogeneity penalty prices proof-of-work by cluster size. At submission the ledger embeds each answer and measures the live size of its semantic cluster; a wallet PoW difficulty rises with that size, so a violet-stamped template cloned into one oasis of identical posts makes every copy heavier to post. An honest distinct answer lands in a sparse terrace and costs almost nothing. A sybil farm cannot hide: the more it copies, the steeper its bill, paying real compute per clone instead of one reused draft.
